about: THE rule for which format tokens a showtime pill may drop, as input -> output vectors that the web's FilmFormatSpec (Scala), iOS's FormatTokenFilterTests (Swift) and Android's FormatTokenFilterTest (Kotlin) each hold their tokensToStrip to, case by case, so the three cannot drift. A pill drops the tokens EVERY slot of the film carries. A slot with no dimension token is implicitly 2D when comparing: Kino Rialto writes only DUB where Helios writes 2D DUB, and without the implied 2D one such slot put 2D back on every other pill (kinowo.net/poznan/movie/strus-pedziwiatr-i-zemsta-kojota, 2026-11-22). Only 2D and 3D are dimensions: IMAX, 4DX, ScreenX and the rest are projection systems the vocabulary pairs with either (IMAX 3D, 4DE 3D), so an IMAX slot that does not say 3D is 2D too. A format-less slot sits out: it says nothing at all. formats are space-joined as the API sends them; strip is a set.

cases.name: the Rialto shape: a cinema naming no dimension counts as 2D, so 2D is common
a real 2D/3D film keeps its dimension, a dimensionless slot included
a real 2D/3D film in two versions keeps everything
a 3D slot never takes the implied 2D
a version that differs keeps its tag, the shared 2D drops
a format-less slot sits out of the comparison
no formats at all drop nothing
an IMAX slot that does not say 3D is 2D: 2D drops, IMAX stays on its own pill
a 3D motion-seat slot keeps the 2D on the plain ones
